"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for increasing the Earned Income Tax Credit so that workers can support themselves and their families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for modernizing the unemployment insurance program to close gaps and extend benefits to the workers who now fall outside it.",
